burden.note: The tool's sourced EMS material burden at 10,000 boards (cost-plus EMS practice: 10 % at 1k, 7 % at 10k, 5 % at 100k+ boards); the audit's 5 % applies at 100k+, v2's 6 % was unsourced.

board.note: The tool's market basis (server/data/pcb-market-evidence.ts): Chaoying (超颖) 4–6-layer automotive ASP ¥995.31/m² (2024) × 1.145 (mid of the +12–17 % automotive PCB rise to Q1 2026) × the China table's 6-v-5-layer shape + ¥105/m² class-3 extras (PCBasic). v2 took the top of the rise band and no layer shape; the audit's £16 (range £12–22) was a judgement.

assembly.markupNote: List prices are selling prices — they carry the seller's margin, so no SG&A or profit is added on them (audit P2 / P5; v2 added 10 % + 8 %). Operations priced from rate-book time × rate carry 10 % overhead; £0.14 a board set-up / handling allowance (the audit's).
